topic: The 13-Storey Geometric Abyss of Chand Baori — Part 2
part1_text: You might assume Chand Baori's 3,500 steps are purely decorative, but they cool the 100-foot well by five to six degrees Celsius. How was it engineered? Raja Chanda built an upside-down pyramid. It funneled precious desert rainwater. The true marvel lies below. Part 2 is already on my channel.
